title: Frau Amrein
desc: She has your name before you have hers

sn.e: I live here now.
I live on the third floor.
A woman lives next door.

sn.s: Nebenan ist es immer ganz still.
sn.e: Next door it is always completely quiet.

sn.s: Die Frau nebenan kennt das ganze Haus.
sn.e: The woman next door knows the whole building.

sn.s: Ihre Tür ist gleich neben meiner.
sn.e: Her door is right next to mine.
The door says Amrein.

sn.s: Am ersten Morgen treffe ich sie.
sn.e: On the first morning I meet her.
She is standing in front of her door.
She greets first.
Grüezi, she says.
Grüezi, I say.
Here you always greet.

sn.s: Man grüsst im Haus, auf der Treppe, im Lift.
sn.e: You greet in the building, on the stairs, in the lift.

sn.s: Wer nicht grüsst, meint etwas damit.
sn.e: Somebody who does not greet means something by it.
She looks at me.
She is maybe seventy.

sn.s: Sie ist klein und sehr gerade.
sn.e: She is small and very straight.

sn.s: Sie hat einen Sack in der Hand.
sn.e: She has a bag in her hand.

sn.s: Sie sagt: Sie sind der Neue.
sn.e: She says: you are the new one.
That is not a question.
Yes, I say.
She asks: what is your name?
I say my name.
She says the name back.
She says it correctly.

sn.s: Beim zweiten Mal sagt sie ihn noch besser.
sn.e: The second time she says it even better.

sn.s: Dann fragt sie: Woher kommen Sie?
sn.e: Then she asks: where are you from?
I answer.
I answer briefly and slowly.
She nods and asks more.

sn.s: Sie fragt: Wie lange bleiben Sie?
sn.e: She asks: how long are you staying?
I do not know.

sn.s: Das ist auch eine Antwort, sagt sie.
sn.e: That is an answer too, she says.
She asks: do you work here?

sn.s: Sie fragt: Haben Sie Familie hier?
sn.e: She asks: do you have family here?
She asks a lot.
I answer everything.
I want to ask something too.
But she asks faster.

sn.s: Nach fünf Minuten weiss sie viel von mir.
sn.e: After five minutes she knows a lot about me.

sn.s: Ich weiss nur den Namen von der Tür.
sn.e: I only know the name from the door.

sn.s: Dann sagt sie: Ich bin Frau Amrein.
sn.e: Then she says: I am Frau Amrein.
Not Vreni, not Frau Vreni.
Frau Amrein.
I say: pleased to meet you.
She asks: are you learning German?
Yes, I say. A little.

sn.s: Dann muss ich langsam reden, sagt sie.
sn.e: Then I have to speak slowly, she says.
And she speaks more slowly.
But not much more slowly.
She asks: do you cook?
A little, I say.

sn.s: Sie schaut mich an und sagt nichts.
sn.e: She looks at me and says nothing.

sn.s: Dann fragt sie: Haben Sie einen Tisch?
sn.e: Then she asks: do you have a table?
No, I say.
A chair?
Not that either.

sn.s: Sie sagt: Sie wohnen also auf dem Boden.
sn.e: She says: so you are living on the floor.
Yes, I say.

sn.s: Am Abend klopft es an meiner Tür.
sn.e: In the evening there is a knock at my door.

sn.s: Vor der Tür steht ein Stuhl.
sn.e: There is a chair outside the door.

sn.s: Der Stuhl ist alt und braun.
sn.e: The chair is old and brown.
Nobody is there.
I take the chair.

sn.s: Am nächsten Morgen grüsse ich zuerst.
sn.e: The next morning I greet first.
Grüezi, Frau Amrein.

sn.s: Sie nickt und sagt nichts vom Stuhl.
sn.e: She nods and says nothing about the chair.

sn.s: Ich sage merci vielmal für den Stuhl.
sn.e: I say merci vielmal for the chair.
She says: which chair?
And goes down the stairs.
That is how she is.

sn.s: Sie wohnt seit vierzig Jahren hier.
sn.e: She has lived here for forty years.
Forty years in the same building.
She knows every family.
She knows everybody in the building.

sn.s: Sie kennt auch die Leute nebenan.
sn.e: She knows the people next door too.

sn.s: Sie kennt den Hauswart seit zwanzig Jahren.
sn.e: She has known the caretaker for twenty years.

sn.s: Und den Bäcker an der Ecke.
sn.e: And the baker on the corner.

sn.s: Sie weiss, wer wann kommt und geht.
sn.e: She knows who comes and goes when.

sn.s: Sie ist die Zeitung von diesem Haus.
sn.e: She is this building's newspaper.
I ask her something once.
I ask about the post office.
She answers at length and exactly.

sn.s: Sie antwortet auf eine Frage mit vier Antworten.
sn.e: She answers one question with four answers.
I understand half.
But I find the post office.

sn.s: Sie fragt: Und? Finden Sie die Post?
sn.e: She asks: well? Do you find the post office?

sn.s: Am nächsten Tag fragt sie danach.
sn.e: The next day she asks about it.
She forgets nothing.
So Frau Amrein lives next door.

sn.s: Sie ist siebzig und sie will alles wissen.
sn.e: She is seventy and she wants to know everything.
She asks too much.

sn.s: Und sie stellt einen Stuhl vor die Tür.
sn.e: And she puts a chair outside the door.
The two things go together.
I do not know her yet.
But she knows me already.

sn.s: Das ist hier normal, glaube ich.
sn.e: That is normal here, I think.

sn.s: Am dritten Tag sagt sie meinen Namen.
sn.e: On the third day she says my name.
She says it correctly.

sn.s: Niemand sonst in dieser Stadt kennt meinen Namen.
sn.e: Nobody else in this town knows my name.
She does.
